day_shape: 80 items: US proposes UN Security Council resolution threatening Iran sanctions over Strait of Hormuz, Trump pauses US naval escorts citing 'great progress', French vessel attacked in the Strait, UAE air defences engage Iranian missiles and drones, UK-France 51-country Hormuz summit readout, heavy IRIB/Defa Press cycle.

threads.label: UN resolution and Hormuz coalition
threads.summary: Secretary Rubio announced a proposed UN Security Council resolution to defend freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, with talks beginning on possible sanctions if Tehran does not halt threats to shipping. A UK-France joint statement reported 51 countries convened on 17 April for an international Hormuz summit co-chaired by Macron and Starmer.

threads.label: Trump pauses Hormuz escorts, diplomacy
threads.summary: Trump announced a pause in US operations facilitating ship movement through the Strait of Hormuz, citing 'great progress' towards a deal with Iran, while Hegseth said the ceasefire is 'not over' and the US is 'not looking for a fight'. Rubio also spoke with Russian FM Lavrov at Lavrov's request, discussing Iran among other topics.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz attacks and US naval posture
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported a French vessel was targeted in the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday, wounding crew, while UAE air defences engaged Iranian missiles and drones and an explosion was reported in western Tehran. CENTCOM posted imagery of USS George H.W. Bush, USS Tripoli, USS Michael Murphy and F-16 patrols, saying 51 vessels had been turned around under the US naval blockade.

threads.label: Iranian state messaging on Hormuz and war
threads.summary: Defa Press published items framing the closure of the Strait of Hormuz as 'the most significant naval blockade in human history' and promoting the 'Arash 2' drone, while IRIB reported Araghchi held calls with Saudi FM Faisal bin Farhan and met China's Wang Yi in Beijing. Khamenei's office posted Workers' Day and Teachers' Day excerpts and a message from Mojtaba Khamenei describing a 'Dey 1404 coup' as a war imposed by the US and Israel.

threads.label: Lebanon, Hezbollah and Gaza tracks
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck approximately 25 Hezbollah targets in southern Lebanon and killed two Hezbollah operatives via drone, while Rubio said peace between Israel and Lebanon was achievable but Hezbollah was the main obstacle. The Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post reported wide gaps between Hamas and the Board of Peace on disarmament, with the Board reportedly unwilling to hold Israel to truce terms if Hamas rejects the offer.

threads.label: Humanitarian and economic fallout in Iran
threads.summary: OCHA's Iran humanitarian update reported damage to nearly 149,000 civilian units and noted the temporary 7 April ceasefire had been extended, while UNHCR cited 24.3 million forcibly displaced people across the affected region. Iran International reported widening unemployment, unpaid wages and inflation after the ceasefire, with ILNA pushing back against official figures.

threads.label: Internal repression and IRGC cross-border strike
threads.summary: IRIB reported that assets of '40 traitors to the homeland' had been seized in Hamadan province, Iran International reported the arrest of a doctor and anesthesia nurse in Najafabad on security charges, and the Jerusalem Post reported the IRGC struck the Surdash camp in Iraqi Kurdistan with two drones. Iran International also reported pro-regime graffiti in a Los Angeles Iranian-American neighbourhood and Trump's remarks that Iranians need access to weapons.
